1. (Judgment 1) Tonight reads as a rerun of 2026-10-27, "a victory banner flung to the right edge." It repeats the lowercase heavy right-aligned word on a two-hue duotone/rule ground, with a diagonal axis, edge-bound placement, and a dense, even, balanced layout. The hero also restates 2026-10-30's "Zeldman and Rolex hired one person for both" in other words, and the bricolage-manrope lowercase chassis repeats 2026-10-23. Change the silhouette so the hero object is not a right-flung word. Change the type chassis too, so a returning visitor would not take this for 10-27.

2. (Judgment 5) The signals grid says "holes in one: 1 · golf." The record says `holesInOne: 4`.

3. (Judgment 5) Spaceman is described as "A one-person studio that carried products from first sketch to shipped code." The record calls it the LLC Doug operates under, working "sometimes as a solo contributor, sometimes embedded in a larger team," across product design, frontend engineering, design systems and brand. Its meta also reads "studio," but the record's type is "Founder." Rewrite both from the record.

4. (Judgment 5) The dougmar.ch band says "a new design ships here every morning — one person designing and building it, overnight." The record says a pipeline of Claude agents rebuilds the site unattended each morning. Doug does not design and build it overnight. Restate it from the record.

5. (Judgment 4) At 360 the dougmar.ch callout band sits before the signals strip. The declared `order` puts the signals strip before the site callout. Move the callout below the signals.

6. (Judgment 5) The role line reads "DESIGNER AND DEVELOPER." The record's role is "Product Designer & Developer." Set the record's wording.

The right half holds the Spaceman featured card instead, so the word is not flung against the right margin as declared. Move "one" to the right column, flush to the right padding edge in rows 1–2, and right-align the deck beneath it. Place the featured card where it no longer occupies the lead's zone.

2. Only the hue and the italic differ. Break the silhouette: move "one" off the top-right corner, for example by anchoring it low across the centre line between the two halves, or by letting it span the split. Change at least one of case, weight or alignment in the hero register so it no longer reads as 10-27 in teal.

"Design and engineering as one job, not two teams passing files," with "one" as the lead word, says what 2026-10-30's "Zeldman and Rolex hired one person for both" said in other words, one person doing both disciplines. If the phrase stays, the staging has to carry all of the difference, so swap the display face and pull the word away from the corner position used on 10-27.

TeeTurn's record says only "Responsible for product direction and strategy," and Twittertale and Politweets were built with Jason Garber and the Character140 collective. Retitle so the line does not claim sole building, or drop the count-and-hand framing.
